messages:
Maya P.: Planning a terraform apply tied to release v2.3.0 tonight — minor IAM policy tweak on service-role + add IP block rule to prod ALB SG. Proposing change window 23:00-23:30 UTC. Any blockers?

Tom C.: Is 23:00 ok? We have a customer demo that might overlap at 22:00-22:30, so 23:00 is better for me.

Alex H.: 23:00 works for infra oncall, pls add a staging canary first.

Maya P.: Will run staging at 20:00 UTC, smoke tests + metrics check. Plan summary (staging plan):
```
Plan: add 2, change 1, destroy 0
+ aws_security_group_rule.block_ip
~ aws_iam_role.redwood_service (policy_documents changed)
```
No destroy, no state resource moves.

Liz (devops): A couple requests:
- pin aws provider at 5.0.2 in module to avoid drift
- add a `pre_apply` S3 backup of state: `aws s3 cp s3://tf-state/prod.tfstate /tmp/prod.tfstate.bak`
- include `apply_guard` var to prevent accidental run outside window

Maya P.: Updated branch with provider pin + pre_apply hook. PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/merge_requests/421 — CI passed. deploy-bot: checks ✅

deploy-bot: CI pipeline passed for branch release/v2.3.0-tn. All required approvals present.

Alex H.: For rollback, prefer: restore backed-up state + run `terraform apply` from previous commit OR explicitly remove the new security rule via `terraform apply -target=aws_security_group_rule.block_ip` if it's the only issue. Document both in the runbook.

Rachel S.: Add a paged runbook for support: if 5xx spike > 5% over 5m, rollback immediately and notify customers. Tag the incident channel.

Tom C.: Will monitor ALB 5xx and backend latency during canary and prod. I'll add Grafana alert thresholds for the window.

Liz (devops): Make sure state lock is used: `terraform apply` will use remote state lock, but if we need to force-unlock: `terraform force-unlock <lock-id>` with coord via #eng-oncall.

Maya P.: Staging canary scheduled 20:00 UTC. Prod apply scheduled 23:00 UTC. I'll post a short status update in #incidents when I start.

Alex H.: +1 from infra. Please tag the exact commit hash in release notes and pin the module versions.

Maya P.: Noted. Release notes will include commit abc1234 and steps to revert.

infra-bot: auto-note: Deploy window reserved 2026-06-22 23:00-23:30 UTC. Lock requested: true.

Liz (devops): :thumbsup: I'll be on standby for force-unlock and state restore.

Maya P.: Running staging plan now (20:00). Will report results in 20–25m.

Tom C.: :eyes:

Maya P.: Staging smoke green, no errors, metrics stable. Proceeding to prod at 23:00 UTC as planned.

Rachel S.: Noted — I will pre-create a support ticket template and post it to #support in case of regressions.

Maya P.: Prod apply complete at 23:07 UTC. Changes applied: ip block added, IAM policy updated. No errors during apply. Monitoring for 30m.

Tom C.: Observability OK so far, no 5xx spike.

Alex H.: Closing the window at 23:37 UTC. Marking release v2.3.0 deployed.

Maya P.: Will follow up with a short postmortem-style note in #eng-releases tomorrow with the exact TF plan and diffs. Thanks all :rocket:
